I ran ES|QL queries against `devto-articles` (488 documents). Every count below came from the query engine. Two notes on how the matching works:
- **"About A2A"** means the title contains `A2A` or `Agent2Agent`. That gives 45 posts. In 63 posts the term appears somewhere in the body, but those extra posts aren't listed here.
- **"Links to a Google codelab"** means the body contains `codelabs.developers.google.com`. That gives 91 posts with 69 distinct titles, because many are cross-posted to both `dev.to/gde` and `dev.to/aws-builders`.

Of the 45 A2A posts, 30 link a codelab and 15 don't. ✅ = links a codelab.
